args.sql:
SELECT
    p.panemark AS panel_id,
    p.tempcoef AS coefficient,
    e.celltempc AS temperature,
    jsonb_extract_path(prf.efficiency_profile, 'current_efficiency', 'curreffpct') AS efficiency_metric,
    jsonb_extract_path(e.irradiance_conditions, 'irradiance_types', '3') AS plane_of_array_irradiance,
FROM 
    panel AS p
JOIN 
    environment AS e ON p.hubregistry = e.arearegistry
JOIN 
    performance AS prf ON p.panemark = prf.solmodref;
